description: Source code for a remote server implementation handling WebSocket communication, commands, and metrics subscription for remote control functionality.

classes.name: remote_server_impl
classes.description: Implementation of remote server handling WebSocket connections, commands, and metrics.

methods.name: build_error_response
methods.description: Constructs a JSON error message with optional command info.

methods.name: build_success_response
methods.description: Constructs a JSON success message with command info.

methods.name: remote_server_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing server commands and settings.

methods.name: get_metrics_gateway
methods.description: Returns the metrics gateway interface if enabled.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket server and listens for connections.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server and joins the thread.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends metrics data to all subscribers.

methods.name: add_commands
methods.description: Adds remote commands to the server.

methods.name: subscribe_metrics_client
methods.description: Adds current client to metrics subscribers.

methods.name: unsubscribe_metrics_client
methods.description: Removes current client from metrics subscribers.

methods.name: handle_command
methods.description: Parses and executes incoming command messages.
